primary_question: Does retention-only produce a material improvement in target-tissue exposure over CereVasc's existing delivery, without compromising drainage?
comparator: CereVasc US11850390B2 (existing endovascular delivery — NOT lumbar puncture)

groups.B: Retention-only architecture (size-selective membrane, no spatial separation)

success: Group B AUC >= 150% of Group A (conservative; model predicts 288%)
failure: Group B AUC <= 100% of Group A OR drainage compromised
design: Ovine, n=6 per group, 48h, FITC-dextran 150 kDa
note: Sharper than V8.5: tests ONLY retention (the load-bearing mechanism), not the combined architecture. If retention-only works, the flagship claim is validated. If not, the territory needs a new mechanism hypothesis.
